_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

From the Mountains#000.src: Find out what's going on at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

From the Mountains#001.src: Mmph! Humnym! Mah houfhs fhs on fifhre! Gft hfrelp, tiff brafze womd strfp!
From the Mountains#001.dst: 읍읍! 인흔! 우히 지희 부히 나혀여! 두흥 불허혀, 불히 안 꺼혀!
From the Mountains#001.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#002.src: Ouh hff do hflp! I hff nho glue wfhtsh doon fifs!
From the Mountains#002.dst: 도후혀 달하구혀! 뭐흘 해야 할히 모르헸어혀!
From the Mountains#002.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#003.src: Find what Arnod wants inside of the house.
From the Mountains#003.dst: Arnod가 원하는 것을 집 안에서 찾으세요.

From the Mountains#004.src: ...well, that explains why you didn't help. But, uh, did the RAGING FIRE escape your notice somehow?!
From the Mountains#004.dst: ...그래서 도와주지 않았군요. 그런데, 어, 그 활활 타는 불은 어떻게 못 보신 거예요?!
From the Mountains#004.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#005.src: I don't care who it is, get me help!! I don't care if you do it, I don't care if you get someone to do it, but someone's got to help with this crazy re-igniting fire!
From the Mountains#005.dst: 누구든 상관없으니 도움 좀 불러 줘요!! 당신이 직접 하든, 다른 사람을 부르든 상관없어요. 자꾸 다시 붙는 이 미친 불을 누가 좀 꺼 줘야 해요!
From the Mountains#005.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#006.src: Check around {p} if you need to, but hurry up already! My house is going to burn to ashes if you don't hurry!
From the Mountains#006.dst: 필요하면 {p} 근처를 찾아보세요. 근데 제발 서둘러요! 안 서두르면 우리 집이 잿더미가 된다고요!
From the Mountains#006.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#007.src: Find someone in {p} who can help you with the fires.

From the Mountains#008.src: Hm... where am I going to get help now- Mh? You're one of those human types, right? Do you have-
From the Mountains#008.dst: 흠... 이제 어디서 도움을 구하지- 응? 너 인간 부류지? 혹시-
From the Mountains#008.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#009.src: Huh? Someone's house is on fire? Guess that's a little more pressing than what I was going to ask. Where is it?
From the Mountains#009.dst: 응? 누구 집에 불이 났다고? 내가 물어보려던 것보다 급하겠네. 어디야?
From the Mountains#009.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#010.src: Oh, that valley by the gate? I think I know where you mean. Let's walk together. So, tell me what exactly happened?
From the Mountains#010.dst: 아, 성문 옆 그 골짜기? 어딘지 알 것 같아. 같이 가자. 그래서, 정확히 무슨 일이 있었는데?
From the Mountains#010.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#011.src: Ah, so you're like a mercenary then, and you found this man's house on fire. He said... what? It re-ignited itself? Well, that doesn't make any sense.
From the Mountains#011.dst: 아, 그러니까 넌 용병 같은 거고, 이 남자 집에 불난 걸 발견했다. 그 사람이... 뭐? 불이 저절로 다시 붙는다고? 말이 안 되는데.
From the Mountains#011.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#012.src: Eh, I'll see when we get there. Oh, what am I doing over here? Yeah, I suppose I do look different from the fare you'd have seen. Well, I'm a dwarf.
From the Mountains#012.dst: 뭐, 가 보면 알겠지. 아, 내가 여기서 뭐 하냐고? 그래, 네가 보던 이들과는 좀 다르게 생겼겠지. 난 드워프야.
From the Mountains#012.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#013.src: Normally I live in the {p}, past the canyons to the east. Guess for yourself what the land is like, considering the name.
From the Mountains#013.dst: 평소엔 동쪽 협곡 너머 {p}에 살아. 이름을 생각하면 거기가 어떤 땅인지 짐작이 갈 거야.
From the Mountains#013.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#014.src: Without getting into too much detail, there's... A few problems, with how it's being governed, and I was trying to drum up support over in {p}.
From the Mountains#014.dst: 자세히 말하진 않겠지만... 거기 통치 방식에 문제가 좀 있어서, {p}에서 지지를 좀 모아 보려던 참이었어.
From the Mountains#014.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#015.src: It, uh. Well, I'm used to getting laughed out of the room back home, but I wasn't expecting to see the same thing over there, just with quartz wallpaper.
From the Mountains#015.dst: 그게, 어. 고향에선 비웃음 사며 쫓겨나는 게 익숙한데, 거기서도 똑같을 줄은 몰랐지. 벽지만 석영이었을 뿐.
From the Mountains#015.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#016.src: I was going to ask if you had any way that you might've been able to help, but...well, I can smell the smoke from here. One thing at a time.
From the Mountains#016.dst: 혹시 도와줄 방법이 있는지 물어보려 했는데... 뭐, 여기서도 연기 냄새가 나네. 하나씩 하자.
From the Mountains#016.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#017.src: ...and where there's smoke, there's fire. This is, uh... that's looking a little more like home, and I'm fairly certain that it isn't supposed to be.
From the Mountains#017.dst: ...아니 땐 굴뚝에 연기 나랴. 이건, 어... 점점 고향처럼 보이는데, 그러면 안 되는 게 확실하거든.
From the Mountains#017.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#018.src: Yep, this fire isn't natural at all... Hell, this almost looks like arson to me!
From the Mountains#018.dst: 그래, 이 불은 전혀 자연스럽지 않아... 젠장, 거의 방화 같은데!
From the Mountains#018.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#019.src: So that's the house, hm? Alright, I'll see what I can do. Might not be able to put it out, but if it's re-igniting, then maybe...
From the Mountains#019.dst: 그래서 저게 그 집이라고? 좋아, 뭘 할 수 있나 보자. 끄진 못해도 다시 붙는 거라면, 어쩌면...
From the Mountains#019.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#020.src: Hm... didn't think they'd be this far out, but it'd make sense if...
From the Mountains#020.dst: 흠... 이렇게 멀리까지 나왔을 줄은 몰랐는데, 만약... 이라면 말이 되지.
From the Mountains#020.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#021.src: Aha! Here's the problem. It's just a little Fleris. Ehm, to explain, they normally live in the Heights.
From the Mountains#021.dst: 아하! 여기 문제가 있네. 그냥 작은 Fleris야. 음, 설명하자면 원래 Heights에 사는 녀석들이야.
From the Mountains#021.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#022.src: Pretty affectionate, good if you can stand the heat, but if you take them away from their mounds they get spooked.
From the Mountains#022.dst: 꽤 애교가 많아서, 열기만 견디면 좋은 친구지. 근데 자기 둥지 언덕에서 떼어 놓으면 겁을 먹어.
From the Mountains#022.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#023.src: One fleris could have kept setting this man's house on fire, but all the other fallout... there's certainly more where this one came from.
From the Mountains#023.dst: Fleris 한 마리로도 이 집에 계속 불이 날 순 있지만, 다른 피해들을 보면... 분명 이 녀석 말고도 더 있어.
From the Mountains#023.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#024.src: Let's go talk to the villager outside. He might've seen where the others got off to, or where they came from.
From the Mountains#024.dst: 밖에 있는 주민한테 가서 얘기해 보자. 다른 녀석들이 어디로 갔는지, 어디서 왔는지 봤을지도 몰라.
From the Mountains#024.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#025.src: Sir, I figured out why your house kept re-igniting and solved that issue, but tell me, have you seen any moving sludgy things around here?
From the Mountains#025.dst: 선생님, 집에 계속 불이 붙던 원인을 찾아서 해결했어요. 그런데 이 근처에서 움직이는 끈적한 뭔가 보셨나요?
From the Mountains#025.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#026.src: Uhm, I don't really know. I've been trying to douse my house so many times over that I haven't really paid attention!
From the Mountains#026.dst: 음, 잘 모르겠어요. 집에 붙은 불을 끄느라 몇 번이고 물을 끼얹느라 제대로 볼 겨를이 없었거든요!
From the Mountains#026.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#027.src: I remember seeing some tar-looking stuff dripping from the mountains behind my house, but that's it!
From the Mountains#027.dst: 집 뒤 산에서 타르 같은 게 뚝뚝 흘러내리는 건 봤어요. 그게 다예요!
From the Mountains#027.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#028.src: Sounds concrete enough to me. Let's check out what's going on on top of the mountain ridge. Check that book of yours if you need directions.
From the Mountains#028.dst: 그 정도면 충분히 확실하네. 산등성이 꼭대기에서 무슨 일인지 확인해 보자. 길을 모르겠으면 네 책을 봐.
From the Mountains#028.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#029.src: Go to the path at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], and follow it up to the top of the mountain.

From the Mountains#030.src: Hm, you're a pretty quick climber. I thought I'd get ahead of you. Well, this looks like the scorched area down in the valley... Hm! I thought so.
From the Mountains#030.dst: 흠, 꽤 빨리 오르네. 내가 앞설 줄 알았는데. 자, 여기도 골짜기 아래 그을린 곳이랑 비슷해... 흠! 역시 그렇군.
From the Mountains#030.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#031.src: There's only one reason I can think of that there would be so many Flerisi around here... If that wagon's reinforced, then...
From the Mountains#031.dst: 이 주변에 Flerisi가 이렇게 많은 이유는 딱 하나밖에 생각이 안 나... 저 수레가 보강돼 있다면, 그럼...
From the Mountains#031.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#032.src: Gah, I knew it. Traffickers! And incompetent ones, too, considering they couldn't hold the things.
From the Mountains#032.dst: 크, 역시나. 밀매꾼이야! 그것도 녀석들을 붙잡아 두지도 못한 서투른 놈들이지.
From the Mountains#032.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#033.src: There's a black market issue in the {p}. Things that you can't find anywhere else is harvested in the Heights for their high value.
From the Mountains#033.dst: {p}에는 암시장 문제가 있어. 다른 데서 못 구하는 것들을 비싸게 팔려고 Heights에서 잡아 가거든.
From the Mountains#033.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#034.src: Flerisi are one of them. In the Heights, they're kept as pets. They're relatively friendly, keep your house warm, and don't need much care...
From the Mountains#034.dst: Flerisi도 그중 하나야. Heights에선 애완동물로 길러. 비교적 순하고, 집을 따뜻하게 해 주고, 손도 별로 안 가지...
From the Mountains#034.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#035.src: ...But if you take them away from a warm place, they burn everything. To think- Some people use the things as weapons. Can't leave well enough alone...
From the Mountains#035.dst: ...하지만 따뜻한 곳에서 떼어 놓으면 뭐든 다 태워 버려. 게다가 이걸 무기로 쓰는 놈들도 있다니. 가만히 두질 못하는군...
From the Mountains#035.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#036.src: We'll need to catch these Flerisi. Here, take this net. While you catch them, I'll repair the cart so we can put them in there later.
From the Mountains#036.dst: 이 Flerisi를 잡아야 해. 여기, 이 그물 받아. 네가 잡는 동안 난 수레를 고칠게. 나중에 거기 넣을 수 있게.
From the Mountains#036.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#037.src: Capture all of the rogue Flerisi and bring them to Axelus.
From the Mountains#037.dst: 날뛰는 Flerisi를 모두 잡아 Axelus에게 데려가세요.

From the Mountains#038.src: I've got the cart all repaired and ready, did you get all the Flerisi? Come over to the cart then. There's still have work to do.
From the Mountains#038.dst: 수레는 다 고쳐서 준비됐어. Flerisi는 다 잡았어? 그럼 수레로 와. 아직 할 일이 남았어.
From the Mountains#038.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#039.src: I'll keep the Flerisi in a smaller fire to keep them calm, see if I can't get them back to the Heights when this is done.
From the Mountains#039.dst: Flerisi는 작은 불 속에 둬서 진정시킬게. 이 일이 끝나면 Heights로 돌려보낼 수 있을지 봐야지.
From the Mountains#039.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#040.src: For now, I want to see if I can find anything on who these traffickers were. Let's see if they left anything in the front of the cart.
From the Mountains#040.dst: 일단 이 밀매꾼들이 누군지 단서가 있나 찾아보고 싶어. 수레 앞쪽에 뭘 남겼는지 보자.
From the Mountains#040.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#041.src: ...oh. Well, didn't notice that the fire went THAT far earlier. That's a problem, isn't it?
From the Mountains#041.dst: ...아. 음, 아까는 불이 그렇게까지 번진 줄 몰랐네. 이거 문제지, 안 그래?
From the Mountains#041.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#042.src: To explain, Flerisi aren't all as tiny as the ones we've found here. They feed of cinders and fire... And for this much damage to be caused, well...
From the Mountains#042.dst: 설명하자면, Flerisi가 다 여기서 찾은 것처럼 작은 건 아니야. 불씨와 불을 먹고 살거든... 이 정도 피해를 내려면, 음...
From the Mountains#042.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#043.src: Methinks this one's getting a bit out of control. This is right next to that big forest, too. Could be a problem if we leave this one be.
From the Mountains#043.dst: 이 녀석은 좀 통제를 벗어난 것 같아. 게다가 바로 옆이 저 큰 숲이야. 그냥 두면 큰일 나겠어.
From the Mountains#043.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#044.src: We're going to have to track it down and subdue it. Here, follow me. I'll dig us down to the valley. Watch a dwarf at work!
From the Mountains#044.dst: 추적해서 제압해야겠어. 자, 따라와. 골짜기까지 땅을 파서 내려갈게. 드워프가 일하는 걸 잘 봐 둬!
From the Mountains#044.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#047.src: Not bad, eh? Anyways, dunno what that huge gate's for, but it looks like our Fleris friend has commandeered it for a bonfire.
From the Mountains#047.dst: 나쁘지 않지? 아무튼, 저 거대한 문이 뭔지는 모르겠지만, 우리 Fleris 친구가 모닥불로 쓰려고 차지한 모양이야.
From the Mountains#047.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#048.src: At least it's a little more contained than I thought, being in that cave, but we still have to catch it. Lead the way. I'm right with you.
From the Mountains#048.dst: 동굴 안이라 생각보단 좀 덜 번졌지만, 그래도 잡아야 해. 앞장서. 바로 뒤에 있을게.
From the Mountains#048.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#049.src: What the...?! It inflamed the creatures in this cave! Fend 'em off!
From the Mountains#049.dst: 뭐야...?! 동굴 속 생물들한테 불을 붙였어! 막아!
From the Mountains#049.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#050.src: There are more of them coming! Get to the end of the cave!
From the Mountains#050.dst: 더 오고 있어! 동굴 끝까지 가!
From the Mountains#050.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#052.src: Both of us stopping is going to make it take too much time, the traffickers might come back!
From the Mountains#052.dst: 둘 다 멈추면 시간이 너무 걸려. 밀매꾼들이 돌아올지도 몰라!
From the Mountains#052.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#053.src: Listen up. I'll handle these things, while you go after the Fleris. If it's a big one like we think, it'll be a downhill battle- It should shrink if you attack it!
From the Mountains#053.dst: 잘 들어. 이놈들은 내가 맡을 테니 넌 Fleris를 쫓아. 생각대로 큰 녀석이면 갈수록 쉬워질 거야. 공격하면 작아질 테니까!
From the Mountains#053.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#054.src: Alright, time for a little royal rumble!
From the Mountains#054.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#056.src: Phew, you're alright! Charred and covered in soot, but that's to be expected. Subdued the Fleris, too! I have the net with me, so allow me.
From the Mountains#056.dst: 휴, 무사하구나! 그을리고 검댕투성이지만, 그건 예상했어. Fleris도 제압했네! 그물은 나한테 있으니 내가 할게.
From the Mountains#056.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#057.src: Well, this is probably a bit of thankless work we just did, but so is a lot of work. Let's get out of here. We can talk outside.
From the Mountains#057.dst: 뭐, 방금 한 일은 아마 알아주는 사람 없는 일이겠지만, 세상 일이 대개 그래. 여기서 나가자. 밖에서 얘기해.
From the Mountains#057.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#058.src: Exit the cave and talk with Axelus at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

From the Mountains#059.src: Well, I say the work is thankless, but that won't stop me, anyways. Thank you for the help, human- This would've been overwhelming alone.
From the Mountains#059.dst: 알아주는 사람 없는 일이라 했지만, 그래도 난 안 멈춰. 도와줘서 고마워, 인간. 혼자였으면 감당 못 했을 거야.
From the Mountains#059.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#060.src: I'll ask the local police force if they've found the traffickers. If they cut and run, well... I got a free cart for the ride home. There's thing for me to attend to there.
From the Mountains#060.dst: 현지 경비대에 밀매꾼을 찾았는지 물어볼게. 도망쳤다면, 뭐... 집에 타고 갈 공짜 수레는 생긴 셈이지. 거기서 처리할 일이 있거든.
From the Mountains#060.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#061.src: Oh, where are my manners? Never even introduced myself this whole time. The name is Axelus. And yours?
From the Mountains#061.dst: 아, 내 정신 좀 봐. 여태 내 소개도 안 했네. 난 Axelus야. 넌?
From the Mountains#061.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#062.src: {u}, huh? I'll try and remember that. For now, take this armor for the trouble. Safe travels, {u}!
From the Mountains#062.dst: {u}, 그렇구나? 기억해 둘게. 우선 수고했으니 이 갑옷 받아. 조심히 가, {u}!
From the Mountains#062.speaker: Axelus
